text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While you can downplay opinions as
simply
subjective, it's difficult to ignore
the many forms
in which they're
expressed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Support, praise, envy, criticism... Some
comments
may be pleasant, but others
can be hurtful...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for Kawakami Princess to
show up
at my office, I hurriedly check
through her new
fan letters before she
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess ran in the Queen
Elizabeth II
Cup just a few days ago, so I
made today's
training a little lighter than
usual.
choice_data_list: ……この意見は段ボールにしまっておこう

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-no, not at all! I'm ready for you to
bring on the
heat!
choice_data_list: まだ疲れは取れていないかな？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, her body is stiff
and
constricted. She's not running with
the same ease
she's shown before.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer! And Kawakami
Princess,
long time no see!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You're...

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess, I already talked to
your
trainer about this, but I'd like you
to do a live
appearance on my program.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Tiara tour is over, I'm
hoping you'd
be willing to deliver a
message to our viewers in
your own
words! Please consider it!
choice_data_list: 君が出演したいなら、だけど
貴方が出演したいなら、だけど

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: In my own words...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll do it! Thank you for the opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kawakami Princess and I arrive
at the
venue for the live broadcast.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Trainer! Could you come over
here for a
second?

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned the other day, we've
prepared a
surprise cake to celebrate
Kawakami Princess's
efforts in the Tiara
tour.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
We'll start off by giving her the gift, and
then she
can talk about her future
ambitions, okay?

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
We made the cake her favorite flavor,
too. I'm
glad I asked you beforehand.
Haha, this is so
exciting!
choice_data_list: きっと彼女も喜んでくれると思います

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, the live broadcast begins.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone! Welcome to another episode of Meet the Racers! This week, we're broadcasting live! ♪

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Our guest today is an Umamusume who's
been on
quite a roll recently! It's
Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...It's a pleasure to be here.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Are we a bit nervous?
Hehe... well,
we've got just the antidote
for that!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
In today's program, we've arranged a
surprise
present for you, Kawakami
Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A surprise present?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This must be it... The surprise present
Trainer was
hiding from me before.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, isn't the cake just lovely?! It's
topped with
all of your favorite fruits,
too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —sorry. I'm... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm not elegant, and I'm not
princess-like... I lack
the dignity required
for a race like the Queen
Elizabeth II
Cup...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So please... please forgive me for all my

disrespectful behavior!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Um... Kawakami Princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: ごめんなさい、少しいいですか！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess's shoulders tremble
as tears
well in her eyes. I take her to
the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for making such a scene...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I saw them—all those letters.
choice_data_list: ……どうしたんだ？
……どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"You crushed my favorite racer's chances
in the
Japanese Oaks. Her one and only
big chance."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I can't believe that at the Shuka
Sho—the grand
finale of the Tiara
tour—all you could talk about
was
yourself. Not a single word of praise for
your
opponents."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Everything you say, everything you do,
it's
always about yourself. You're the
worst princess
there is."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"You aren't fit to enter a dignified and
historic
race like the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup. You never
were."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You can be honest with me. I mean, I...
I...
choice_data_list: ……そんなことはないよ

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this is a press conference for racers
entering
the Japanese Oaks. Don't you
think you should
behave more
appropriately?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After all, a princess blows past all the
foes who
stand in her way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I intend to win the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup, like a
true princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess is full of spunk and bravery,
but
blessed with the dignity and grace
to show mercy
to her enemies. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess is strong and shows sincere
respect for
her opponents. I thought I'd
learned that from
Princess Fighter, and
yet...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I tried to paint myself as the only star. I
treated
the other racers not as rivals, but
as foes that
needed to be defeated.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I was arrogant and looked down on the
other
Umamusume. I was incredibly
self-centered!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I hurt the feelings of others without even
realizing
it... Everything is all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's not true. It can't be true. Because I... I...
choice_data_list: ……君のせいじゃない
……貴方のせいじゃない

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a princess at all! That's why no
one thinks I
am! I'm just... I'm just an
embarrassment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her big eyes well up with tears. It looks
like she
could break down at any
moment.
choice_data_list: そんな……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She keeps putting all of the blame on
herself, but
is she really the only one
who should shoulder
that burden?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: 違う、指導できなかった俺の責任だ
違う、指導できなかった私の責任だよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm her trainer. And that means it's my
role to lead
her in the right direction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...I'll hide these opinions in this box.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should never have hidden those
opinions from
her. I should have
explained them honestly, and
taught her
what lessons she could take from them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My job is to lead her along the path to
becoming
a wonderful Umamusume who
feels no shame
when she looks back on
her past.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But I'm the one who actually did all
those things...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-but...
choice_data_list: そうだとしても、俺も反省したいんだ
そうだとしても、私も反省したい

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer... It's not your... It's my...
choice_data_list: そんな想いを背負わせてごめん

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Sob...
choice_data_list: ……お互いに成長しよう

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! I'm sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess loudly bawls her eyes
out.
Once the tears have ceased, we
make a pledge to
keep improving
together.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you're okay? The live
broadcast isn't
over yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry for before. I'd like to say
some final
words, if that would be okay.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
All right. Just don't push yourself if you
don't feel
up to it.
choice_data_list: 俺も同席させてください
私も同席させてください

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
To bring this episode to a close,
Kawakami
Princess has some final words
she'd like to share
with all the viewers
out there.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: 先程は申し訳ございませんでした

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for suddenly losing my
composure and
giving everyone such a
shock. I must have made
the staff worry
terribly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But I swear that from this moment forth,
I will
conduct myself properly as a
princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...So I'd like you all to continue watching
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing the program's viewers head-on,
Kawakami
Princess expresses her
newfound determination
with utmost
sincerity.
choice_data_list: よろしくお願いします

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, I learn that this episode received
around
seventy viewer complaints. I
contact the TV
producer to apologize,
but he tells me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about a thing. I'm still a fan
of
Kawakami Princess, and so is
everyone else here."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Kinko Sho. I'll do
my best to
support her so she can enter
the race as a proud
princess.
